entities.summary: Rashidun, a notable figure in the history of Lebanon, associated with Early Islamic Period and Crusader States (636–1099). Preceded by Arab Conquest and Mount Lebanon Communities and Battle of Yarmouk — Arab forces defeat Byzantines, opening the Levant to Islam. Their legacy influenced Crusader County of Tripoli and Mamluks capture the last Crusader strongholds on the Lebanese coast.
